2134. Checking Whether a String Is a Palindrome

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a word and determine whether it reads the same forward and backward, using a character array and a loop.

Description
Read a string word into a character array using scanf, and find its length using a loop. Use another loop to compare characters from the front and back of the string moving toward the middle, using a flag variable to record whether any mismatch is found. After the loop, use an if-else statement to print "Palindrome" or "Not Palindrome" based on the flag.
input_spec: A single word with no spaces.
output_spec: Print "Palindrome" if the word reads the same forward and backward, otherwise print "Not Palindrome".
